units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 25:9">Targ. Deut. XXV, 9</cite>.—Part. <cite ref="T01035"><he>רָקֵיק</he></cite>; pl. <he>רְקִיקִין</he>. Targ. II Esth. III, 8.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:9:1">Koh. R. to VII, 9</cite> <he>כל דר׳ לעיל וכ׳</he> if a person spits upward, it will fall in his face (an angry person hurts himself). Y. Yeb. XII, end, 13ᵃ top <he>ורַקַּת קדמנא וכ׳</he> she spat before us &c., v. <cite ref="T00434"><he>רוּקָּא</he></cite>; Bab.
<cite ref="Yevamot 106a">Ib. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אכלה תומא ורַקְּתָה</he> if she ate garlic and had to spit.
